                var numParticles = data.GetIntegerProperty("num_particles");

                // vpkstuff patch: arrays of num_particles are allocated before any is read.
                if (numParticles < 0 || numParticles > info.Size / 4)
                {
                    throw new InvalidDataException($"Particle snapshot declares {numParticles} particles in {info.Size} bytes; refusing to parse (malformed or hostile resource).");
                }
